A weekend in Paris is pure romance. Start Saturday with croissants in Montmartre, stroll along the Seine, and climb the Eiffel Tower at sunset. On Sunday, wander the Marais, share a long lunch at a bistro, and end the trip with a romantic dinner cruise. It is the most romantic way to see the city.
